name: Default
shortDescription: Federated, self-hosted video platform with channels, playlists and ActivityPub federation, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: Sign in as root with the password stored in the PT_INITIAL_ROOT_PASSWORD variable. Emails (signup verification, password reset, notifications) are only sent after you add PEERTUBE_SMTP_HOSTNAME, PEERTUBE_SMTP_PORT, PEERTUBE_SMTP_USERNAME, PEERTUBE_SMTP_PASSWORD and PEERTUBE_SMTP_TLS to the environment and redeploy; SMTP cannot be set from the administration panel.
PeerTube does not support changing its domain after the first start. Set the final domain before deploying.
Live streaming ingest uses RTMP on port 1935, which is not routed by this template; regular video uploads and playback work over HTTPS.
